trans-unit.source: Restore or permanently remove deleted records
trans-unit.target: Gendan eller fjern slettede elementer permanent

trans-unit.source: Allows you to restore deleted records or remove them permanently from the database. Supports single, multiple, and recursive actions, such as restoring a page with all its content elements. Filter by page or table to review deleted records before taking action.
trans-unit.target: Tillader dig at gendanne slettede elementer eller fjerne dem permanent fra databasen. Understøtter enkelte, flere, og rekursive handlinger, såsom at genoprette en side med alle dens indholdselementer. Filtrér efter side eller tabel for at gennemgå slettede elementer, før du gennemfører handlingen.
